title: China agrees to forgo a nuclear program
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of China agrees to forgo a nuclear program, about 1963 at China, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: China agreed. China agreed that they would not pursue any nuclear program at all.

plain: A researcher named Dan Sheehan, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that in 1963 China agreed not to pursue any nuclear weapons program at all, and he links this to China's leader at the time, Mao Zedong. He tells it as part of a larger story about President John F. Kennedy, where it would show how much was being quietly arranged between world powers in that year.
